from_author: Zheng Chuyang (project lead), image labeled before (red) vs after (blue)
filter_algorithm: Frozen before external fetch in R11_FROZEN_CREATOR_STAGE_INTERPRETATION.json; red/blue pixel thresholds on right side of exact image, then two largest color connected regions sorted by x.
numeric_observation: Two large colored glyph components change in opposite directions while preserving near-constant overall width, rather than both being scaled wider or narrower.

intended_designer_process.source_direct_statement: The designer describes adjustment of the 阝 component across multiple characters and a rollback of globally too-wide 口 after scaling to thousands of glyphs.
intended_designer_process.evidenced_shape_behavior: The two largest before/after color regions exhibit +3.54% and -3.79% bounding-width changes; this is evidence of differential reshaping within the illustration, not a reusable formula.
intended_designer_process.candidate_decision: contextual counter-shaping + repeated-component group consistency audit + ability to reverse earlier attractive changes
intended_designer_process.support_type: source grounded shape observation AND real designer first-person reasoning
intended_designer_process.unproven_cause: No proof that measured +3.54%/-3.79% deltas were consciously selected or are optimal.

study_only_constraints: Colored components are extracted with simple thresholds; labels/overlays do not provide source vectors
Do not reuse the absolute percentages as a font-generation recipe
Pixel segment bounds do not guarantee calligraphic quality or distinctiveness
No source pixels or glyph outlines copied or publicly republished
No unseen characters were designed or human blind assessed
